attributes.name: Ajin Ra Baqa
attributes.powers:
When you fail a check to defeat, Ajin Ra Baqa does not deal damage as usual; instead you are dealt 1 Cold damage for each die rolled on that check.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location the henchman came from.
